Fast mode prioritizes speed, offering up to 2.5x faster output token generation, for rapid iteration, live debugging, and interactive agents where output speed results in a better user experience. Input and output tokens are $8 and $40 per million. See the full list of features available on Claude Models on Google Cloud in our documentation (opens in new tab) . Customers using the Anthropic managed offering also get access to the Claude Console, Anthropic’s development environment for observing and managing agents with Claude. The Console includes tools to write prompts and configure agents, run them on hosted environments, monitor usage and costs, and manage access and security per workspace. Claude Fable 5.1, Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5, and Haiku 5.5 are available, with new models shipping on the Anthropic managed offering as they launch. There are two ways to build with Claude on Google Cloud. Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed) is built for customers who want day zero access to all beta and generally available Claude Platform features. It’s best for customers who want full Claude Platform feature parity, accessed through Google Cloud. Anthropic operates the service and acts as the data processor. Claude Models on Google Cloud (Google managed) remains the best choice for customers who need Google Cloud as the data processor, have strict regional data residency requirements, or want native Google Cloud integrations like Model Armor or Agent Engine. The Anthropic managed offering is generally available today. To get started, open Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed) (opens in new tab) or explore the documentation (opens in new tab) .
